payload.categoryName: Home, Garden & Furniture / Home Storage / Furniture
payload.description:
Rattan Construction: Crafted from durable polyethylene rattan, featuring a hand-woven design for enhanced texture and charm.
Natural Hue: Boasts a beautiful honey color, providing a natural brown aesthetic that complements various bathroom decors.
Versatile Storage: Ideal for use as a bathroom wastebasket and for decorative storage purposes.
Compact Dimensions: Measures 11 inches in height, with a top diameter of 9 inches and a bottom diameter of 7 inches.
Practical Capacity: Offers a 2.5-gallon capacity, suitable for keeping bathrooms tidy and organized.
Easy Maintenance: Includes a removable plastic liner, facilitating convenient and straightforward cleaning.
